name: TAB name is lost after reloading desktop view
description:
## Summary

1. Bug: desktop tab names were lost after a page reload in codx-junior's dockview layout.
2. Root cause: `extractAppsFromLayout` in `src/store/views.js` read non-existent fields (`panel.name`, `panel.componentName`, `panel.key`) from dockview's serialized panels.
3. This stored every restored app as `name: 'Unknown'`, which shadowed the correctly persisted `params.tabName` in `Tab.vue`.
4. Fix: read the tab name from `panel.params.app` (with fallbacks to `params.tabName` and `panel.title`) and the component from `panel.contentComponent`.
5. Only one file changed — `src/store/views.js` — keeping chats, boards, and workspace tab behavior untouched.
